data.description: Respecting differences — hook: 'they are sharing their preference with you' (not a dead condition about 'wanting to respect')

dev says to Susie : if someone likes something different from you
dev says to Susie : if they are sharing their preference with you
dev says to Susie : then you should respect their choice
[Cond:Reset]

dev says to Susie : if they are sharing their preference with you
dev says to Susie : then you should say that is okay and people have different tastes
